###Extended Data Figure 4
```{r Extended Data Figure 6a}
# DimPlot of resolution of wsnn_res.0.2 with wnn.umap
DimPlot(RGL_Astrocyte, group.by = "wsnn_res.0.2", reduction = "wnn.umap")
```

```{r Extended Data Figure 6b}
# DimPlot of Subtype population with umap.rna
DimPlot(RGL_Astrocyte, group.by = "Subtype", reduction = "umap.rna",cols = RGL_Astrocyte_subtype_color)

# DimPlot of Subtype population with umap.atac
DimPlot(RGL_Astrocyte, group.by = "Subtype", reduction = "umap.atac", cols = RGL_Astrocyte_subtype_color)
```

```{r Extended Data Figure 6c}
#FeaturePlot of gene expression
DefaultAssay(RGL_Astrocyte) <- "RNA"
FeaturePlot(RGL_Astrocyte, reduction = "wnn.umap", features = c("FABP7","ALDH1L1","CD44","NRXN3","SLC1A2","LGR6") )
```

```{r Extended Data Figure 6d}
#RidgePlot of gene expression
RidgePlot(RGL_Astrocyte, group.by="Subtype", features=c("SOX2","GLIS3","FABP7","ALDH1L1","ALDH1A1","GFAP","CD44","DPP10","NRXN3","ROBO2","SLC1A2","LGR6","SEMA3E","MOBP"), 
          fill.by = "ident",
          col=RGL_Astrocyte_subtype_color,
          stack=T)
```


```{r Extended Data Figure 6e}
adult <- readRDS("output/objects/adult_ref.RDS")

ref_astros <- subset(adult, cell_type=="astrocyte")

ref_astros$Cell_Type <- "Ref_Astrocyte"

ref_astros <- ref_astros %>%
  NormalizeData() %>%
  FindVariableFeatures(selection.method = "vst", nfeatures=3000) %>%
  ScaleData() %>%
  SCTransform(vars.to.regress = NULL)


ref_astros<-ref_astros %>%
  RunPCA(assay = "SCT", npcs = 50) %>%
  RunHarmony(group.by.vars = c("sample_id"),
             reduction = "pca", assay.use = "SCT", reduction.save = "rna") %>%
  RunUMAP(reduction = "rna", assay = "SCT", dims = 1:50, 
          reduction.name = 'umap.rna', reduction.key = 'rnaUMAP_') %>%
  FindNeighbors() %>%
  FindClusters(verbose = TRUE)

# assign subtypes
FeaturePlot(ref_astros, features = 
              c("GFAP", "AQP4", "ALDH1L1","CD44","ROBO2","SLC1A2","PTN"), 
            coord.fixed = T,
            reduction = "umap.rna")

VlnPlot(ref_astros, group.by = "SCT_snn_res.0.8",features = 
          c("GFAP", "AQP4", "ALDH1L1","CD44","ROBO2","SLC1A2","PTN"),
        pt.size = 0, layer="counts", ncol = 4)


DimPlot(ref_astros,group.by = "SCT_snn_res.0.8" , reduction = "umap.rna")


clust_map<-c("0"= "EAAT2-hi Astrocyte",
  "1"= "CD44-hi Astrocyte",
  "2"= "CD44-hi Astrocyte",
  "3"= "CD44-hi Astrocyte",
  "4"= "EAAT2-hi Astrocyte",
  "5"= "CD44-hi Astrocyte",
  "6"= "EAAT2-hi Astrocyte")
ref_astros$Subtype <-""


for (clust in names(clust_map)) {
  ref_astros$Subtype[ref_astros$SCT_snn_res.0.8 == clust] <- clust_map[clust]
}

RGL_Astrocyte_subtype_color = c("Radial Glia" = "#e2e700", "CD44-hi Astrocyte" = "#FFA500","EAAT2-hi Astrocyte" = "#FF4F00",
                                "OL-like Astrocyte" = "#C2A162","Undetermined Astrocyte" = "#4F4F4F")

ref_astros$Subtype <- factor(ref_astros$Subtype, names(RGL_Astrocyte_subtype_color[2:3]))

# plots for 6e
DimPlot(ref_astros,group.by = "SCT_snn_res.0.8" , reduction = "umap.rna")
DimPlot(ref_astros,group.by = "Subtype",cols = RGL_Astrocyte_subtype_color) 

```

```{r Extended Data Figure 6f}
VlnPlot(ref_astros, group.by = "Subtype",features = 
          c("GFAP", "AQP4", "ALDH1L1","CD44","ROBO2","SLC1A2","PTN"),
        pt.size = 0, layer="counts", ncol = 7,cols = RGL_Astrocyte_subtype_color)
```



```{r Extended Data Figure 6g}
# subset different subtypes for next step
RGL_Astrocyte <-subset(RGL_Astrocyte, idents = c("Radial Glia", "CD-hi Astrocyte", "EAAT2-hi Astrocyte"))
# Transcription factor foorprinting
RGL_Astrocyte <- Footprint(
  object = RGL_Astrocyte,
  motif.name = c("RFX2","RFX3","RFX4","RORB","FOS"),
  genome = BSgenome.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg38)


# plot the footprint data for each Subtype
Idents(RGL_Astrocyte) <- "Subtype"

PlotFootprint(RGL_Astrocyte,features = c("RFX2","RFX3","RFX4","RORB","FOS")) & scale_color_manual(values = RGL_Astrocyte_subtype_color)

```
